title: Navi Chart catalog entry
description: One chart type in the Navi Chart catalog. See docs/adr/0002-catalog-as-data.md for why this is the source of truth, and docs/design-language/PRINCIPLES.md rule 1 for the reuse-before-invention rule this schema exists to enforce.

name.description: The catalog display name, e.g. 'Range Capsules'.

card_title.description: The in-card <h2> conclusion-style headline used to locate the <div class="card"> block in the gallery file (RESEARCH.md §1's retrieval method). Null only for whole-page interactive templates that have no single card.

card_anchor_id.description: The chart mark's DOM id attribute inside its card (e.g. 'rungs', 'dayline') — a more reliable machine anchor than the card title for scripted lookups. Null if not applicable/unknown.

data_shape.description: English description of the data contract this chart honestly encodes. This is the selection primary key per SKILL.md step 1.

occasion.description: English description of the intended use context.

gallery_file.description: Path under templates/ (or templates/color/ for a palette variant) that holds the real implementation.

legacy_anchor.description: The historical B1/C1-style HTML comment shorthand still present in some gallery files from before a family was renamed (RESEARCH.md §7). Null if the entry never had one.

tier.description: primary = default candidate pool (L1-L15, F1-F13, and all Glance/Maps/interactive entries participate in their own family's default pool). backup = only used after primary is checked and rejected for cause, or the entry is one of the five documented shape-specific exceptions (F15, F16, F17, L17, L20) that skip that comparison. See PRINCIPLES.md rule 1 and SKILL.md hard rule 3.

siblings.description: Same-topic alternates used to compare data contracts and recall candidates during selection. Does not imply both should be generated, and does not override the tier/default-order rules.

note.description: Optional qualifier, e.g. 'range only', 'upgrade at two variables'.

notes.description: Free-text footnote carried from the source catalog (e.g. an engine caveat, a removed-sibling explanation).

origin.description: 'upstream' for the 64 entries this fork inherited; 'extension' for anything scaffolded later via `npm run new-chart` (ADR-0005). New PRINCIPLES.md §8 accessible-name checks in scripts/validate.ts apply only to 'extension' entries — see docs/design-language/UNKNOWNS.md U1 for why the upstream set isn't retrofitted yet.
